posts.body_html:
so this seed batch turned out to have a number of interesting and colorful individuals. Here's one that kept Adrian Slack's white lid-that was the feature I was after in the cross. Perhaps a few cultivars may spring out of this cross-I know it has been done by other breeders.

So far, this individual is looking very promising. It has a vibrant pinkish-red body and red-veined white top, which is an excellent contrast of colors:

posts.body_html:
Thanks guys! All of the photos that I've put on this post are of the same clone-the only plant in existance! As you know, this is in the very early stages-it looks like the plant is forming multiple growth points, and I'm really baby-ing it.

what's great is it doesn't require a greenhouse to get those colors, and the white and pink become darker as the pitcher ages. The contrasting bright white lid with the and dark red/pink body is really the hilight of this clone. I can only imagine what this will look like under twin wall polycarbonate-I bet that body can get even darker and the white even brighter!
